Definition: probably akin to G979 (through the idea of vital activity); force:--violence.
BiblicalUsage: Force is the word for violence, and Luke uses it three times, each time around the apostles in danger. In Acts 5:26 the captain brings the apostles without violence, fearing the people; in Acts 21:35 Paul is carried by the soldiers for the violence of the crowd; and in Acts 27:41 the ship breaks apart under the violence of the waves.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Luke keeps showing me the same thing: the gospel moves through violence without using it, and God keeps his servants in the middle of it.
